name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/OBC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
description: Financial assistance to students from economically disadvantaged SC/OBC backgrounds studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable completion of education.
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition and non-refundable fees
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers
Monthly allowance of ₹550/month for day scholars
Additional disability allowance of ₹2,000/annum for benchmark disability
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Log in and select 'Fresh Application'
Fill personal, academic, and bank details accurately
Upload all required documents in PDF/JPEG format
Submit application and note your Application ID
Track status on the portal using your Application ID

name: Ayushman Bharat — PM-JAY Health Cover
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
description: Comprehensive government-funded health assurance providing cashless secondary and tertiary inpatient care to eligible families.
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per year
Coverage across empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide
No cap on family size or age for coverage
Pre-existing conditions covered from day one
application_steps: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Aadhaar or ration card
Visit nearest empaneled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC)
Request Ayushman Card generation with Aadhaar OTP verification
Download Ayushman Bharat Card (ABHA card)
Present card at empaneled hospital for cashless treatment

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year directly into bank accounts of landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000
Direct transfer to Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT
No intermediaries — direct to farmer's account
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click 'Farmer Corner'
Select 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number and complete OTP verification
Fill land and bank account details accurately
Submit — registration is verified by local revenue authority
Receive installments directly in bank account after verification

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Urban (PMAY-U)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
description: Housing for All mission providing financial assistance for construction or purchase of affordable housing for urban citizens.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans
Direct grant for construction of pucca house with basic amenities
Coverage for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG)
application_steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in and select appropriate component
Register using Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Fill application with property and income details
Upload required documents
Submit to Urban Local Body (ULB) for verification
Track application status on portal after submission

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers ensuring fixed pension after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60
Based on contribution amount selected at enrollment
Government co-contributes 50% for eligible subscribers
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or use net banking portal
Fill APY enrollment form with Aadhaar and bank details
Select desired monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000)
Set up auto-debit from savings account for monthly contributions
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) via SMS/email

name: KALIA Scheme (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
description: Odisha Government scheme providing comprehensive financial assistance to small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural labourers, and vulnerable agricultural households.
benefits: ₹10,000 per family per year for cultivation support
₹2,000 per vulnerable person for livelihood activities
Interest-free crop loans for eligible farmers
Life insurance of ₹2 lakh and accidental insurance of ₹2 lakh
application_steps: Visit kalia.odisha.gov.in or Common Service Centre
Check if your name appears in the KALIA beneficiary list
If not listed, submit grievance online with Aadhaar details
Verify bank account details and Aadhaar seeding
Receive benefits directly in Aadhaar-linked bank account

name: Mukhyamantri Medhabruti Scholarship (Odisha)
department: School & Mass Education Department, Government of Odisha
description: Merit-based scholarship for students who have passed Class 10 and 12 from Odisha schools with distinction, encouraging higher education.
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 depending on marks
For meritorious students continuing higher studies in Odisha
application_steps: Visit scholarship.odisha.gov.in and register
Select 'Mukhyamantri Medhabruti' scheme
Enter board exam roll number and marks
Upload documents and bank details
Submit — institution verifies and forwards to district
Scholarship credited annually to bank account

name: PM Mudra Yojana — Micro Enterprise Loan
description: Collateral-free micro loans for non-farm micro and small enterprises to support business startup and expansion.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50,000 (Shishu category)
Loans up to ₹5 lakh (Kishor) or ₹10 lakh (Tarun)
Subsidized interest rates through participating banks and MFIs
MUDRA RuPay Debit Card for business expenses
required_documents: Quotation for assets to be purchased
application_steps: Identify your loan category: Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishor (₹50K-5L), Tarun (₹5L-10L)
Visit nearest bank, MFI, or NBFC participating in MUDRA scheme
Fill MUDRA loan application form
Submit KYC documents and business details
Bank processes and sanctions loan — typically 7-14 working days
Receive MUDRA Card (RuPay) for business expenses
